newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Memtec says qtr op profit up 80 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Memtec says qtr op profit up 80 pct.

text.p: Water filtration company Memtec Ltd said on Thursday its operating profit jumped to US$2.9 million for the three months ended September 30, compared with $1.6 million a year earlier.
Earnings per share for the quarter were 21 cents.

Memtec said first quarter operating profit from its Filterite division fell 16 percent to US$1.6 million while Fluid Dynamics' operating profit while Fluid Dynamics operating profit fell 62 percent to US$616,000.
Memtec's Seitz division recorded an operating profit of US$1.3 million.

Memtec chairman Denis Hanley said the quarter was impacted by several factors, including the strong performance by the new Seitz line, capacity constraints in Fluid Dynamics' Florida facility and the recognition of additional tax loss benefits.
